name: Trail of Suffering Encounter Routine
description: Walk to room, single right-click, verify banner, left-click (disabled), press Q for 3s, and run WASD key loop for 50s

steps.description: Navigate around map boundary maintaining 20px distance from edge
Verify Trail of Suffering encounter banner is visible on screen
Left-click Trail of Suffering banner (DISABLED for now)
Press Q for 3 seconds and release it
Run around room using S, D, W, A (2s each) in a loop for 50 seconds
